summary: Universal Electronics Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the sale of claims related to unlawfully imposed tariffs to a third-party financial institution for $7.6 million. This monetization of a contingent asset is a one-off liquidity event, not a corporate special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity beyond standard assignment terms is disclosed. The 'what to watch' is minimal — the filing merely documents a cash receipt; no arbitrage angle exists.
